timeouts._comment: Bumped from 300s/900s after DeepSeek V4 Pro hit timeouts on larger prompts. Older agents still finish well within.

_runs_comment: PREREGISTRATION.md §6 fixes N = 10 runs per arm × scenario × agent for the confirmatory run (N ≥ 5 pilot). The March-era value of 3 had ~zero power (Holm-corrected p ≈ 1.0 across the board on 2026-07-04).
_judges_comment: Two-family judge panel (2026-11-08 amendment): gemini-3.5-flash + gemini-2.5-pro + claude-haiku-5-5. Agent under test = DeepSeek V4 Pro; no judge shares the agent's family (the axis that prevents self-preference, arXiv 2502.01534). The claude_haiku seat replaces gemini-3.1-flash-lite, ending the all-Google monoculture disclosed in the 2026-07-05 second amendment; the two Gemini seats remain a correlated pair, so a 2-of-3 majority can still be decided by Google lineage alone. Anthropic seat is funded by the Max-plan monthly API credits ($100/cycle, hard stop when exhausted, no overage) at $0.10/$0.50 per MTok. OPENAI_API_KEY in .env is still invalid.

cloud.description: Uses each agent's default cloud API (Anthropic, Google)

ollama.description: Routes all agents through local Ollama for controlled comparison

_deferred_comment: Scenario E (continual coding, write-side memorize) is exercised separately — it is fragile and even SWE-Bench-CL reports continual-coding memory as empirically inconclusive. Run with: node harness/runner.js --scenario scenario-E-continual --agent claude.
